scope: DXF parser allocation-failure safety for HATCH spline boundary data. This is local parser hardening and generated regression evidence; it does not qualify DWG HATCH support or native application semantics.
changes: Reserve HATCH spline knot and weight vectors before consuming their DXF values, so a failed allocation leaves the same group retryable.
Reject spline knot, control, and fit count declarations smaller than data already parsed; retain count and active-boundary state until required reserves succeed.
Advance HATCH spline control and fit coordinate component ordinals only after the coordinate object is available and assigned.
Reserve boundary-handle storage before ending the active spline edge or committing the handle count.
